newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London quiet after Tokyo gains.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London quiet after Tokyo gains.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London edged up on Friday in an uncertain market after the Nikkei 225 stormed ahead in Tokyo overnight, traders said. The Nikkei 50 index was at 1372.60 points, up 23.79 points from Thursday's London close by 1446 GMT. There was some firmness in blue chip stocks early in the session, traders said, with Toyota 3145.T, Sony and Cannon well bid. Dealers said they were surprised by the Tokyo surge and were uncertain how the market would perform on Monday.
"What we've gained we'll probably lose. But you never know what will happen -- people might come in on Monday feeling brave and decide they want to buy," one said.
The Nikkei average of 225 leading shares jumped 465.97 points or 2.61 percent to close at 18,330.01 on Friday.
